profile_text.body:
Arthur AI describes itself as providing AI governance for everyone, uniting security, finance, and the teams shipping AI on one control plane. Per its site, the platform covers performance, observability, guardrails, and governance across the full AI lifecycle, and is aimed at measuring, monitoring, and governing enterprise AI at scale.

The site lists several capabilities. Discovery finds agents running on endpoints, cloud, private data centers, and elsewhere in a company's compute environment, which the company says lets AI leaders, builders, and security teams enforce policies. Guardrails and security policies are deployed for real-time protection, and Agent Behavioral Analytics (ABA) monitors AI applications and alerts on anomalous behavior, suspicious patterns, and indicators of compromise. The platform also tracks spending by team and user, detects requests that do not need an expensive model, and reroutes them, including to internally hosted open-source models. The site quotes a customer saying Arthur will drop their maintenance workload by 50% and that a first production model went from idea to implemented in a few hours.

The site's product listing describes Arthur AI as a model monitoring and governance offering with bias mitigation, fairness metrics, and compliance reporting. No litigation, filings, or other third-party records are held for the company.
